name: Baleni salt production at a mineral spring
description: At Baleni, archaeological ceramics and production deposits near a mineral spring provide evidence for salt production by early farming communities.

date.label: 251–547 CE, calibrated context sample
date.basis: Date of the stated witness or contextual sample, not a claim of global origin.

events.statement: At Baleni, archaeological ceramics and production deposits near a mineral spring provide evidence for salt production by early farming communities.

evidence.locator: pp. 109–111, BAL03 event 4 and Kwale ceramics
evidence.supports: Baleni salt-making deposits contain use-altered ceramics. BAL03 event 4 carbon sample Pta-9422 has a reported calibrated interval of 251–547 CE; the paper treats the older event 5 sample cautiously because of possible old wood and movement.

events.caveats: The 251–547 CE interval dates a carbon sample from one production deposit, not the mineral spring, all salt production or the invention of salt-making. An older sample may reflect old wood or disturbance; modern ethnographic processes are not assumed identical to ancient practice.
